Name: AirBaltic
HQ Location: Latvia, Marupes District, 3 Tehnikas Iela, lv-1053
Company description: airBaltic is a strong and internationally respected airline with the main hub in Riga and bases in Tallinn and Vilnius. We're connecting the Baltic States to 80 destinations across Europe, the Middle East, North Africa, and the Caucasus region, providing essential infrastructure and global connectivity for the region.    The airline was founded in 1995. The hybrid strategy integrates the best practices of both traditional network airlines and low-cost carriers. airBaltic stands out as one of Europe's most punctual airlines and currently operates one of the world's youngest fleet – Airbus A220-300 exclusively.   airBaltic's commitment to excellence is recognized by numerous prestigious awards, including being named the Best Airline in its region by Skytrax for three consecutive years.  In 2025, airBaltic made its debut in the global rankings compiled by Airline Ratings, which recognized it among the world’s 50 safest and overall best airlines, as well as one of the leading global airlines in sustainability and among the most preferred airlines in Europe and the UK.  The same year, APEX awarded the company the Five Star Major Airline Award for its commitment to providing a high-quality travel experience and before that – the Passenger Choice Award for Best Cabin Service in Europe.    With a workforce exceeding 2800 talented individuals representing over 30 nationalities, airBaltic is not only expanding but also fostering diversity within its ranks. airBaltic proudly holds a position among the TOP3 most desired employers in Latvia, a testament to our positive reputation within the industry.

Name: Refundor
Company description: We are a travel consulting company with strong emphasis on air passengers’ rights. Our mission is to help you make travelling less stressful. We know the frustrating feeling when your flight is cancelled after a long time of planning or have been delayed for hours, affecting your connected flight. Stress, a ruined vacation and additional expenses. That's why we decided to start Refundor, a company consulting clients about travelling and adventures, starting with a focus on air-passenger rights. We started small - helping our friends and family to claim compensations for delayed or cancelled flights, and have since grown into a well-known and respected company, helping clients from all around the world.
